changelog:
- Initial release of the tianapi-icp-query skill.
- Supports querying Chinese website ICP record information, including record number, subject name, type, status, and update time.
- Requires API Key from TianAPI (TIANAPI_ICP_KEY) for use.
- Usage includes Python script and direct API call examples.
- Detailed guidance on configuration, usage, and error handling included in documentation.
